newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee and cocoa recover, sugar mixed PM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee and cocoa recover, sugar mixed PM.

text.p: COFFEE - Heads higher across the board as the market rebounds from a five-month low of $1,530 basis Sept. Up $20 at $1,605 at 1459 GMT.
COCOA - Regains some strength to hover near day's peak after overcoming some setback following weaker NY. Sept up three stg at 1,048 stg a tonne.
SUGAR - Expiring August higher but rest mixed after another uninspired NY performance. Aug/Oct spread widens. Oct down 20 cents at $317.00.
